description: 令和3年経済センサス活動調査結果_第22表_産業中分類別事業所数、従業者数、事業に従事する者の人件費及び派遣受入者に係る人材派遣会社への支払額、原材料・燃料・電力の使用額等、製造品出荷額等及び粗付加価値額(従業者4人以上の事業所)(長崎市) [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 長崎市. 長崎市の令和3年経済センサス活動調査結果です。 産業（中分類）別にみた事業所数、従業者数、人件費、原材料使用額、製造品出荷額等及び粗付加価値額の結果等を示しています。 （注1）集計結果をそのまま公表すると個々の報告者の秘密が漏れるおそれがあるため秘匿した箇所については、空欄としています。. Coverage: 長崎市. The portal files it under the publisher 長崎市. Its tags are 経済センサス活動調査. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-03-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
